# Local PDF dependencies

Invoice data is processed on this device. No PDF generation service or CDN receives it.

- jsPDF 4.2.1, MIT. Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/jspdf/-/jspdf-4.2.1.tgz
  npm package SHA-512 (verified): `YyAXyvnmjTbR4bHQRLzex3CuINCDlQnBqoSYyjJwTP2x9jDLuKDzy7aKUl0hgx3uhcl7xzg32agn5vlie6HIlQ==`.
  The UMD browser build and licence are included here.
- Noto Sans Regular, SIL Open Font License. Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf
  Font and licence are included here. It provides consistent invoice typography and the Indian rupee glyph. Unsupported scripts can use browser Print / Save PDF.

Retrieved 25 October 2026. The original TCG logo is reused from the existing site asset; only its empty outer padding is cropped for document layout.
